image.identity_policy: record image Id and RepoDigests before deployment; source tag plus Dockerfile hash is not a runtime digest claim; unavailable identity fails before official deployment

traffic.server_retry_policy: no completed-window retry; readiness polls every 0.1 seconds for at most 5 seconds before the window starts; teardown precedes the next window

pre_state.policy: exactly one root noqueue record; any other qdisc or any filter fails before recovery intent or mutation

qdisc.seed_policy: iproute2 in ind-linux:0.1 has no frozen portable deterministic NetEm seed contract; record tc/kernel versions and accept stochastic placement only within the predeclared binomial bound; never claim reproducible packet positions
qdisc.journal_policy: write recovery intent and PLANNED action atomically before first forward command; record ATTEMPTED before each command and acceptance afterward

partial_states.name: root_only
partial_states.recovery: delete root 10: then verify exact noqueue 0:

partial_states.name: root_and_child
partial_states.recovery: delete root 10: recursively then verify exact noqueue 0:

qdisc.idempotent_recovery: inspect first: exact noqueue 0: is already restored; only netem 10: with optional pfifo 20: may be deleted; all other states fail closed; inspect again and require exact noqueue 0: with no filters

warm_up.purpose: route, neighbor and tool readiness only

fault.justification: 150 frozen ping trials reduce loss-sampling variability without selecting results

restoration.justification: same fixed count as fault windows; every window must satisfy baseline thresholds

timeline.action: capture initial interface and qdisc counters
start 20-second iperf3 TCP client after bounded server readiness
wait for both commands, then capture final counters and qdisc state

windows.clock: time.monotonic_ns for ordering/duration plus UTC timestamps for provenance
windows.synchronization: one controller assigns one immutable window_id, starts client, waits by monotonic deadline until t=5, starts ping, joins both bounded commands, and rejects the whole window if startup skew exceeds 0.250 seconds
windows.failure_policy: any command, parse, readiness, timeout, skew or counter failure makes the entire window unavailable; no selective feature/window retry

features.source: hosta ping stdout summary plus individual replies
features.fault_aggregation: total losses divided by 150 across exactly three valid windows
features.unavailable: any ping chain invalid or any fault window unavailable

features.source: successful individual hosta ping reply RTTs
features.fault_aggregation: pool all successful samples from exactly three valid windows and select ceil(0.95*n)-1
features.unavailable: zero successful RTT samples or any invalid fault window

features.fault_aggregation: median of exactly three valid per-window values
features.unavailable: nonzero exit, malformed JSON, missing/nonpositive end.sum_received.bits_per_second or any fault window unavailable

features.source: r2 eth2 tx_bytes delta with r3 eth1 rx_bytes cross-check
features.fault_aggregation: median of exactly three valid per-window values
features.unavailable: counter reset, nonpositive elapsed time, ratio outside [0,1], absent/nonpositive speed, speed changes, or r2/r3 speed provenance disagrees
features.denominator: read /sys/class/net/eth2/speed on r2 and /sys/class/net/eth1/speed on r3 before every phase; require equal positive integer Mbps and corroborating ethtool records; never use nominal topology capacity

features.source: tc -j -s child pfifo 20: dropped counter only
features.per_window: after minus before on kind pfifo handle 20: parent 10:1
features.fault_aggregation: sum of exactly three valid child-pfifo deltas
features.unavailable: missing/duplicate/malformed handle, owner mismatch or counter reset; NetEm 10: dropped never maps to this feature

features.source: direct tc qdisc and root/ingress filter JSON on r2 eth2
features.per_window: false only when no tbf/htb/cake/police/rate action exists and only the phase-approved noqueue or netem/pfifo hierarchy is present
features.fault_aggregation: false only when all three valid windows directly prove absence
features.unavailable: configuration output unavailable/malformed or any unapproved qdisc/filter present

effectiveness.criterion: MUTATION_EFFECTIVE only when exact netem 10: random 10% 0% and pfifo ownership are observed, NetEm counters are available, all three ping windows are valid, and aggregate drops are 6..25 inclusive; diagnosis and non-loss predicates are forbidden inputs
effectiveness.separation_stop: if child pfifo 20: drop delta is nonzero from NetEm impairment, preserve diagnostic tree and stop as empirically non-separating

rule.required_availability: all six observed after Feature Vector v2 validation
rule.explanation_template: Configured NetEm packet loss on r2:eth2 produced independently effective measured loss while all required conditional F1 predicates remained exact.

rerun_policy.retry_rule: a retry always creates a new tree and is allowed only before recovery intent/PLANNED exists; never overwrite
rerun_policy.post_mutation: every outcome after recovery intent or PLANNED is durable diagnostic history; no opportunistic rerun or selective discard
rerun_policy.authoritative: all source/runtime gates, six-feature availability, independent effectiveness, empirical qdisc separation, exact conditional signature/rule/diagnosis, restoration, standalone replay, baseline-after, raw hashes and cleanup pass
rerun_policy.diagnostic_non_authoritative: physical fault is effective but signature does not separate, any required observation is unavailable, counters do not separate, or any post-mutation acceptance condition fails
